# THE KHADI AND VILLAGE INDUSTRIES COMMISSION ACT, 1956

 ACT NO. 61 OF 1956

[25th September, 1956.]

# An Act to provide for the establishment of a Commission for the development of Khadi and
 Village Industries and for matters connected therewith.
